title: Co-Branded Card Reduction on Summit Reinstatement Fees
content:
Holders of the Crestline co-branded card pay less to reinstate expired Crestline Summit Loyalty Program miles. The card is shown by the companion certificate issued on a card anniversary, as its record under the Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes charter shows it.

**Rule.**

- A Crestline Companion Certificate First or Premium Economy issued within the last 12 months takes 40 USD off.
- A Crestline Companion Certificate Main Cabin or Main Plus issued within the last 12 months takes 20 USD off.
- A member with no such certificate issued in that span takes nothing off.

"Within the last 12 months" means fewer than 12 whole calendar months from the certificate's issue date to the day of the reinstatement. Hypothetical boundary: a certificate issued on 18 February 2025 is inside the span on 17 February 2026 and outside it on 18 February 2026.

The reduction is taken off the fee to pay and never takes it below zero.

**Hypothetical reading.** A card-anniversary Crestline Companion Certificate First issued four months ago takes 40 USD off; a Crestline Companion Certificate Main Cabin issued thirteen months ago takes nothing off.
